rows: Quarter-size hail reported in Cotulla as well as in Los Angeles from same storm.
Reported at a truck stop on I-35 near the La Salle and Frio County line (between Millet and Dilley).

63 mph wind gust measured at Cotulla (COT). Roof was blown off trailer on Houston Street in Cotulla. Sheriff Office reported wind damage to the I-35 bridge at F.M. 468, where concrete chunks were lying under the bridge.

A thunderstorm produced microburst over the city of Encinal. Broadcast media, from nearby Laredo, reported a large aluminum section of roof from an old school building in Encinal was blown off and carried downwind roughly one block into a house. One telephone pole was also split …

The bow echo that impacted northwest Webb county continued northeast into southern La Salle county, causing damage in the town of Encinal. There was damage to the siding of a few trailer homes. The sheet metal on a several structures was peeled back, and even taken off in some ca…
Large truck was pushed off Interstate 35 due to thunderstorm winds.
Numerous large tree limbs were snapped throughout the city of Cotulla.

Tornado touched down along Farm to Market Road 468 near the Dimmit County line. The tornado flipped an 18 wheeler then proceeded northeast about 5 miles. The tornado then crossed Farm to Market Road 469 and struck an oil hydraulic fracturing flow back site. The tornado flipped on…
The ASOS site at the La Salle County Airport near Cotulla reported a 53 knot gust.
Coop observer reported golf ball sized hail near Fowlerton.
Spotter reported quarter sized hail on Farm to Market Road 1582 north of Fowlerton.
Picture received via social media of at least quarter sized hail in Cotulla. Time estimated by radar.
Large tree limbs were blown down at the Chaparral Wildlife Management Area.
Winds snapped or uprooted trees near Los Angeles.
Quarter sized hail was reported in Fowlerton.
Public reported penny sized hail occurred in Encinal.
Quarter sized hail occurred near Artesia Wells.

NWS storm survey confirmed an EF-1 tornado caused damage on a private ranch in rural northwest La Salle County. The tornado touched down near Johnson Ranch Road just northeast of Farm to Market Road 468. A rancher was thrown from his barn and landed on top of his trailer. Numerou…
A tornado moved across a ranch and damaged a couple of barns. Three trees were uprooted and many branches were broken.
Pictures submitted from the public showed large mesquite trees blown down. Roof damage occurred to a church.
Ping pong ball sized hail occurred in Cotulla causing damage to plants. Images relayed to the NWS through Facebook.
Quarter sized hail occurred at the Big's Travel Center near Interstate 35 in Cotulla.
Spotter reported a brief rain wrapped tornado.
Dime sized hail occurred at Artesia Wells.
Heavy amount of nickel sized hail was reported by the public through social media.
Video was submitted of hail falling near Cotulla. Hail was measured to the size of half dollars.
Cotulla-La Salle County Airport ASOS measured a gust to 59 MPH.
Cotulla-La Salle County Airport ASOS measured a gust to 53 knots.
Cotulla-La Salle County Airport ASOS measured an additional wind gust to 53 knots.
Law enforcement reported quarter sized hail east of Encinal.
Business signs and power lines were blown down near Interstate 35 in Cotulla.
Cotulla-La Salle County Airport ASOS measured a gust to 70 mph.
Cotulla-La Salle County Airport ASOS measured a gust to 59 mph.
Small to medium sized branches were broken from trees near Artesia Wells.
Winds damaged a barn, windmill and water container north of Encinal.
Cotulla/La Salle County Municipal Airport ASOS measured a gust to 58 knots.
Public report was received with pictures showing golf ball to tennis ball sized hail that broke a skylight in Cotulla.
The Cotulla/La Salle County Airport ASOS recorded a wind gust to 70 mph.
La Salle County Sheriff's Office reported hail damage to cars, including broken windshields, in Cotulla from hail up to the size of softballs. The large hail broke windows in several homes.
Public reported through social media that golf ball sized hail occurred in Cotulla.
Public posted video of nickel to quarter sized hail falling in Cotulla.
KCOT ASOS recorded a severe wind gust of 56 knots (64 mph) as a strong thunderstorm bowed through northern La Salle County and Cotulla.
ASOS station KCOT in Cotulla, TX measured a wind gust of 60 mph likely due to efficient evaporative cooling in wake of an anvil from a strong to severe thunderstorm to its south.
Thunderstorm wind damage report in Cotulla of chance fencing blown down at the Tx DOT facility.
Trained spotter reported quarter size hail in Cotulla.
Power cables damaged, trees down, and roofs damaged throughout the town of Cotulla.
Two tractor trailers blown over 5 SSW of town (estimated on I-35).
